composition_rules.default: Combine non-conflicting commands into one unified image operation.
composition_rules.same_category_conflict: Last explicit command wins unless the earlier command is a master/multi-view command and the later command is a modifier.
composition_rules.master_rule: A command with mode=master controls the output structure; all compatible commands become modifiers of that master operation.
composition_rules.multiple_masters: If multiple master commands are present, combine only when logically nestable; otherwise the last master wins. Example: /360view /contactsheet is nestable; /explodedview /beforeafter is nestable; /360view /explodedview defaults to exploded view rendered at multiple angles only if the user clearly wants both, otherwise last master wins.
composition_rules.unknown_commands: Do not silently invent a meaning. If the token is clearly a natural modifier, treat it as free-text; otherwise state that the command is unknown and suggest the closest known command.
composition_rules.parameter_binding: Text immediately following a parameterized slash command belongs to that command until the next slash command.
